description: This file defines an abstract repository interface (ITaskRepository) and a concrete implementation (TaskRepository) for managing TaskItem objects in Firebase Firestore, including methods for streaming, fetching, creating/updating, and deleting tasks, as well as handling notifications scheduling.

classes.name: ITaskRepository
classes.description: Abstract interface defining the methods for task data operations such as streaming, fetching, upserting, and deleting tasks.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: A Firestore-backed implementation of ITaskRepository that manages TaskItem data and integrates with Flutter's notification system.

methods.name: streamTasks
methods.description: Streams a list of TaskItems for the specified user, ordered by last updated time.

methods.name: streamTask
methods.description: Streams a single TaskItem by its ID for the specified user.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a single TaskItem by its ID once.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates or updates a TaskItem in Firestore and schedules reminders if applicable.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a TaskItem from Firestore and cancels related reminders.

methods.name: _requireUid
methods.description: Internal helper to ensure a valid user ID is provided, either directly or via a provider function.
